title: Nepal Prime Minister Shah to undertake two-day visit to India from Nov 22

ai.summary: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah will visit India for two days starting November 22, 2026, as part of diplomatic engagement with Prime Minister Modi.

facts.claim: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah will leave for New Delhi on November 22
facts.quote: Kathmandu, Nov 20: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah will leave for New Delhi on November 22 on a two-day official visit at the invitation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on Friday.

facts.claim: This would be Shah’s first official bilateral foreign visit after taking office on March 27
facts.quote: This would be Shah’s first official bilateral foreign visit after taking office on March 27.

facts.claim: Shah, 36, will lead a 34-member delegation that also includes Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle and Minister for Foreign Affairs Shisir Khanal
facts.quote: Shah, 36, will lead a 34-member delegation that also includes Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle and Minister for Foreign Affairs Shisir Khanal

facts.claim: Shah will call on President Droupadi Murmu and hold delegation-level talks with Modi during the visit
facts.quote: Shah will call on President Droupadi Murmu and hold delegation-level talks with Modi during the visit.

facts.claim: The high-level discussion will feature matters relating to the expansion of economic cooperation in areas such as trade, transit, energy, investment, besides connectivity network and infrastructure development
facts.quote: The high-level discussion will feature matters relating to the expansion of economic cooperation in areas such as trade, transit, energy, investment, besides connectivity network and infrastructure development

facts.claim: This will help further expand mutual collaboration in areas of priority between the two countries
facts.quote: This will help further expand mutual collaboration in areas of priority between the two countries

facts.claim: Shah had received an invitation from Modi to visit India when the government led by the Rastriya Swatantra Party leader was formed in March
facts.quote: Shah had received an invitation from Modi to visit India when the government led by the Rastriya Swatantra Party leader was formed in March
